---
title: "About"
---

This is an online tool to learn more about the postbase system in Inupiaq while also engaging with Inupiat stories.

<u> How to use this tool </u>
<p> This tool offers a way to read Inupiat stories online and interact with the structure of the language. This can help learners see how different elements of a word interact with each other in different ways. </p> 

<p> There is an option to read each story in Inupiaq only, or Inupiaq and English. Additionally, if you hover your mouse over specific words, a pop-up bubble will offer information about the structure of the Inupiaq word and any additional or helpful notes. </p>
